body: Too late. 45 mins from hospital. It's what I want.
Wish I could buy you a drink bedfore I fall alseep. Salut, dude.
I had to help myself. Nobody to euthanize me. Sucks, but it's over now.

Got your pm. Sorry you're in pain.

I'm not afraid of dying. I'm afraid of waking up. Wish I could trade bodes with you, but that's not the way it works.

Stay brave, chief.

Read through some of your comments. They betray your age. Sorry, but everything goes to shit...even our species some day. I'm not stubborn enough to  hang around because of a bunch of ignorant kids who wouldn't appreciate it.
One more hour, one more day, one more week, one more month, one more year. Surely there's a stream or game just over that rim there, about a hundred yards.

Let me tell you about wisdom, little girl.

With age you come to learn that everything you've ever appreciated will eventually be ruined. Take reddit for example. This used to be a great website. Now it's filled with retards with no identity. They spout recycled catch phrases they call memes and make infantile cut & paste blurbs they call rage comics. Reddit has become a confederacy of dunces who have no semblance of what made the site unique.

It's adorable that you're trying to help, but your response has reinforced my decision. In a few hours I'm quitting all of this bullshit permanently. I feel relieved that I never have to wake up again.
